samples.xml_description:
<module id="fixed_point_subtractor">
    <description>A module that implements a fixed-point subtractor for precise arithmetic operations with fixed precision.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="a" width_description="[N-1:0]">First N-bit fixed-point input operand.</input>
        <input id="b" width_description="[N-1:0]">Second N-bit fixed-point input operand.</input>
        <output id="c" width_description="[N-1:0]">N-bit output representing the result of the fixed-point subtraction.</output>
        
        <parameter id="Q" type="integer" value="0">Represents the number of fractional bits in the fixed-point representation.</parameter>
        <parameter id="N" type="integer" value="0">Represents the total number of bits (both integer and fractional) used for inputs and outputs.</parameter>
    </ports>
    
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="ZERO" type="reg" value="0">Constant value 0.</parameter>
        <parameter id="ONE" type="reg" value="1">Constant value 1.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    
    <logic_description>
        <sequential_logic id="res" type="register" width_description="[N-1:0]" reset_value="[N-1:0]0">Register to store the result of the subtraction operation.</sequential_logic>
    </logic_description>
    
    <implementation>
        // Implementing same-sign subtraction
        assign c = ({N{a[N-1]}} == {N{b[N-1]}})? ((a[N-1:0] - b[N-1:0]) | {(N){~(|(a[N-1:0] ^ b[N-1:0]))}}): {{(N-Q+1){1'bx}}, (((a[N-1:0] + b[N-1:0]) & {N{~a[N-1]}}) | (~((a[N-1:0] + b[N-1:0]) & {N{a[N-1]}})))};
    </implementation>
</module>
